conflicts.fact: Universal indicator colour/pH reading for vinegar (pH meter value 2.8 vs indicator pH 3)
conflicts.versions: Fact sheet gives universal indicator vinegar orange (pH 3), and lessons 3 and 8 report pH 3 on the indicator chart while the pH meter value is 2.8. Lesson 8 explicitly notes the difference (indicator chart pH 3, meter value 2.8). Lesson 3 does not mention this difference and lists indicator pH 3 alongside meter pH 2.8 without explanation, which could confuse learners.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 3 model building: draws H+ and OH- ions in each product as a first draft, contradicting Lesson 2 and Lesson 4/5 which say particle drawings of H+ and OH- come later (Lesson 4 first H+ version, Lesson 5 adds OH-)
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2: particle drawings with H+ and OH- will be added in later lessons. Lesson 3: learners draw a first draft with many H+ in lemon juice and more OH- in soap. Lesson 4: 'draw the first H+ ion version of their Model' and leaves baking soda and soap blank 'To be added in Lesson 5'. Lesson 5: 'In Lesson 4 our model only had H+.'
